name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Welfare8_113年婦女生活狀況調查_20251118
data_description_en:
1. The ROC year 113 survey, per the Public Assistance Act, takes low-income and middle-low-income households under municipalities/counties as the survey subjects for a status survey.
2. Data collected includes household basic information (e.g. population count, gender, age, education level), employment status, occupation and industry, household income and expenditure status, social participation, retirement life preparedness, and awareness of related regulations and services.
3. This survey item is filled in based on administrative data, or is not applicable/cannot be answered.
notes_en: 1. Survey years covered include 1998, 2002, 2006, 2011, 2019, and 2024, but formats differ across years, so figures are not directly comparable across periods. This center's databases have each undergone separate de-identification processing, removing names, addresses, and other directly identifying fields such as ID numbers, institution codes, insurer unit codes, unified business numbers, dates of birth, visit dates, and admission dates. Data may only be used within the independent work area set up by this center, and only statistical results that have passed review may be taken out, to ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify any specific individual.
